verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, a public GraphQL API for querying data and configuring features, and offers a NerdGraph API explorer for experimenting with it. Programmatic control is reinforced by the official CLI (built on the platform's APIs), Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, and an official MCP server. Missing for 10: docs state NerdGraph configures only 'some' features (full coverage not evidenced), no machine-readable OpenAPI-style spec was found (probe 404s, though GraphQL schema introspection may substitute), no auth or rate-limit details, and no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
